theme.$description: Magic Studio — Light theme (cockpit chrome + Mirror voices). Inherits primitives from tokens-foundation; layers Studio cockpit semantics on top.

bg.$description: Studio surface background — paired with --studio-bg consumer alias

bg-elev.$description: Studio elevated surface — used as the foreground colour for filled chips/pills whose background is the page bg/fg pair (LivePaneToggle active state). Aliases bg in the default scheme so an inverted-fill button's text reads as the surface beneath fg.

toolbar-h.$description: Top toolbar chrome height — paired with --studio-toolbar-h

drawer-h.$description: Bottom drawer collapsed height — paired with --studio-drawer-h

drawer-h-open.$description: Bottom drawer expanded height — paired with --studio-drawer-h-open

pane-left-w.$description: Left brief pane width — paired with --studio-pane-left-w

topbar-h.$description: Studio v0 cockpit top bar height (Option D mockup)

thread-max-w.$description: Studio v0 cockpit thread / main column max width (Option D mockup)

composer-max-w.$description: Studio v0 sticky composer max width (Option D mockup)

flow-sidebar-w.$description: Studio v0 flow sidebar expanded width (Option D mockup)

flow-sidebar-rail-w.$description: Studio v0 flow sidebar collapsed rail width (Option D mockup)

history-panel-w.$description: Studio v0 history / runs panel width (Option D mockup)

variant-card-h.$description: Studio v0 variant card height (Option D mockup)

variant-card-w.$description: Studio v0 variant card width (Option D mockup)

aspect.$description: Studio v0 device-frame aspect ratios for variant previews (Option D mockup)

iphone-15-pro-max.$description: iPhone 15 Pro Max device frame aspect

galaxy-s24.$description: Samsung Galaxy S24 device frame aspect

apple-watch-ultra.$description: Apple Watch Ultra device frame aspect

apple-watch-9.$description: Apple Watch Series 9 device frame aspect

map.$description: Mirror / Map-mode voice colours — one per agent voice in the Council rail

status.$description: Studio status indicator scale — replaces the 10 raw hex literals in magic-studio/src/app/globals.css (status badges, off-system, promote-link, flow-status-pill).
